tasks.description: Implement the first local account data cleanup phase, limited to verified owner-owned leaf rows.
constraints: Exact unified Git diff in JSON, local fixtures only. No deployment, route, role grant, Auth deletion, Storage API or generated worker. Broader T082/T083 remain open.

Forward migration adds one SQL-owner-only SECURITY DEFINER function with empty search_path, owner UUID and request operation UUID. Run the accepted 065 fresh Storage verification in the same transaction, reusing its profile/request locks. When not ready return false with no deleted rows. On verified readiness remove only rows with precisely p_owner_id from recovery_transitions, care_reversals, schedule_changes and notification_claims, independent of tombstone state. No dynamic deletion predicates. Recoverable failure must roll back the transaction; exact successful repeat is harmless and returns true. No request/receipt, parent care objects, profile/Auth, quota, payments or neighbor changes. Keep ACLs private even with default custom grants.

Rollback pgTAP against real fixture owners covers active/guest/wrong op, failed verification including reappearing objects, successful exact purge with neighbor leaves and untouched target parent records/receipts, replay, actual owner-only ACL. Honor registration-anchor immutability; use a distinct anonymous profile, never convert a permanent fixture. Support clean and forward migrations and run existing fixtures.

acceptance_criteria.description: Scoped exact diff and Deno typing.
Clean/upgrade pgTAP verifies fresh Storage block, isolated leaf purging, replay and private ACL.
